race.comment: BILLY NOT SILLY (2) ran above expectations to claim maiden two back then finished fifth last start and beaten 15 lengths at Gosford over 388m (23.00). Back to track where he won his maiden. Can make amends this time. BELLA ZEST (1) showed little early speed at her last couple, the latest finishing sixth (23.05) in a Grade 5 at Gosford. Great chance to atone. CHASING KISSES (8) has an impeccable record this course and distance, winning all three starts. Comes off a (17.17) win last time, scoring by 8 lengths in a Grade 5 over 300m at this track. Can feature in the finish. OCEAN VIBE (7) is not to be discarded.
